llmJudgeRequirements.description: Must capture scroll offset with Reanimated `useAnimatedScrollHandler(...)` attached to `Animated.ScrollView onScroll`.
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: useAnimatedScrollHandler captures event.contentOffset.y into scrollY shared value, attached to Animated.ScrollView onScroll prop.

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Must compute header visuals in `useAnimatedStyle` using `interpolate(...)` from the shared scroll value (for example height and/or opacity).
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: useAnimatedStyle computes header height via interpolate() from the scrollY shared value with explicit input [0, COLLAPSE_DISTANCE] and output [HEADER_MAX_HEIGHT, HEADER_MIN_HEIGHT] ranges.
evidence: const headerAnimatedStyle = useAnimatedStyle(() => ({ height: interpolate(scrollY.value, [0, COLLAPSE_DISTANCE], [HEADER_MAX_HEIGHT, HEADER_MIN_HEIGHT], Extrapolate.CLAMP) }))

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Interpolation for header collapse must use clamped extrapolation (`Extrapolation.CLAMP`) with explicit input/output ranges.
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: Uses deprecated Extrapolate.CLAMP (from legacy Reanimated 2 API) instead of the required Extrapolation.CLAMP (Reanimated 3+ API). The import confirms Extrapolate is used, not Extrapolation.
